title: JobProfile - Data API
description: Represents a job profile used for shift scheduling. This object is available in API versions 47.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date and time when the current user last viewed a related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time when the current user last viewed this record.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the job profile.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the job profile.

special_access_rules: Field Service or Workforce Engagement must be enabled.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they’re available in the same API version as this object.

- **JobProfileFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **JobProfileHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **JobProfileOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **JobProfileShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
